name: @envsemble/atlas-app
description: Atlas desktop app: plans, models and shared understanding for agents and the people they work with
author: envsemble

scripts.package: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --publish never --dir -c.directories.output=release/e2e -c.electronFuses.enableNodeCliInspectArguments=true -c.extraMetadata.atlasEndToEndBuild=true && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.test: node ../scripts/test-tier.mjs full --runner tsx --import ../scripts/test-home.mjs src && node ../scripts/test-tier.mjs full --import ../scripts/test-home.mjs main shared
scripts.test:quick: node ../scripts/test-tier.mjs quick --runner tsx --import ../scripts/test-home.mjs src && node ../scripts/test-tier.mjs quick --import ../scripts/test-home.mjs main shared
